figures.name: average_delay_per_transiting_vessel_all_vessels
figures.notes: No published average (mean/median) added delay per transiting vessel across ALL vessels (booked + unbooked) for any defined window was found. What exists: non-booked average waits by direction (FreightWaves/ACP: peaks 11.4 d SB, 15.2 d NB), a class/direction forecast range (Waterfront via SEKO: 5-15 d), record non-booked highs (Argus: 24 d), and an approximate ~21-day current wait (CNBC, Aug 2023). Booked vessels largely transited on schedule, so no all-vessel mean can be derived from these without inventing the booked population's waits. PA-3 is therefore built on the published forecast range with its basis printed, and degrades to UNGRADED if that basis is rejected.

figures.name: queue_split_atlantic_pacific_peak
figures.notes: No sourced split of the waiting queue by anchorage (Atlantic side vs Pacific side) for the August 2023 peak or any other specific date was found. The ACP queue table reproduced by SEKO (7 Nov 2023) splits by lock and by booked/non-booked only; Reuters (10 Aug 2023) gives a single total of 161 vessels near the canal. No split was estimated.

figures.name: slots_30_application_2023-11-01_to_2023-11-02
figures.notes: Whether the 29 Sep 2023-announced reduction (reported as 30 assigned slots effective 1 Nov 2023) actually applied on 1-2 Nov 2023, before Advisory A-48-2023's schedule began on 3 Nov, could not be verified. A-48-2023 superseded the announcement within days. Immaterial to every derived figure: phase P1 ends 2 Nov 2023 on the pre-announcement 32/day capacity and P2 begins 3 Nov on the A-48 schedule.

baseline_mean_daily_n_total_2023-01-01_t.derivation: Mean of the PortWatch daily n_total values for the 210 days 2023-01-01 through 2023-07-29 inclusive (the pre-slot-restriction window; the first ACP slot cap took effect 2023-07-30), taken verbatim from portwatch_panama_2023-2024.json rows. Sum = 6744; 6744 / 210 = 32.1143, recorded as 32.11 vessels/day.

tightest_phase_mean_daily_n_total_2023-1.derivation: Mean of the PortWatch daily n_total values for the 108 days 2023-12-01 through 2024-03-17 inclusive (the implemented slot floor of 22/day, 1 Dec 2023 - 15 Jan 2024, plus the 24/day plateau, 16 Jan - 17 Mar 2024, ending the day before the first restoration step on 18 Mar 2024), taken verbatim from portwatch_panama_2023-2024.json rows. Sum = 2244; 2244 / 108 = 20.7778, recorded as 20.78 vessels/day. Drop vs baseline: (20.78 - 32.11) / 32.11 = -35.28%.

tightest_window_22_slots_mean_daily_n_to.derivation: Mean of the PortWatch daily n_total values for the 46 days 2023-12-01 through 2024-01-15 inclusive (the implemented 22-slots/day window), taken verbatim from portwatch_panama_2023-2024.json rows. Sum = 971; 971 / 46 = 21.1087, recorded as 21.11 vessels/day. Drop vs baseline: (21.11 - 32.11) / 32.11 = -34.26%. This is PA-1's observed comparator (metric window = the primary shock window).

monthly_mean_daily_n_total.derivation: Calendar-month means of PortWatch daily n_total, recomputed from portwatch_panama_2023-2024.json rows. Lowest month: 2024-01 (19.52/day). Lowest single day in the series: 15 transits on 2023-12-26; highest: 38 on 2023-03-25.
